title: Geometry
description: Uploaded STEP geometry: the topology file the import job writes, the import job's parameters and result, and the wire shapes of /api/geometries (docs/ARCHITECTURE.md sections 3 and 4, ADR-023, ADR-024). Lengths are in metres. Each message is a definition under $defs.

LengthUnit.description: A length unit symbol from packages/spec/units.json.

BoundingBox.description: xmin, ymin, zmin, xmax, ymax, zmax in metres.

UnitReading.description: What the import job read about the file's length unit. Factors are metres per file unit.

declared.description: The unit as the file writes it, for example SI_UNIT(.MILLI.,.METRE.) or 'INCH'; null when it declares none.

detectedUnit.description: The declared unit as a units.json symbol; null when the file declares none, several, an unsupported one, or one whose factor disagrees with the table. The user must then choose one.

problem.description: Why there is no detected unit, in plain language; null when there is one.

readingFactor.description: Metres per file coordinate that OpenCASCADE applies when importing the file as it is (ADR-024).

gmshType.description: Gmsh's own surface type name, for example Plane or BSpline surface.

Topology.description: topology.json: the reference for face identity (ARCHITECTURE.md section 3). Written by the import job in metres, at the geometry's confirmed scale once the unit is confirmed.

size.description: Diagonal of the model's bounding box, in metres.

scaling.description: Geometry.OCCScaling the file was imported with: 1, or the confirmed unit's factor divided by the reading factor.

software.description: Versions that produced the tags. Tags are only stable for the same file and the same versions.

ImportParams.description: Parameters of an import job. confirmedUnit is null on the first import, which reads the file as it is.

ImportResult.description: Result summary of a succeeded import job.

GeometryStatus.description: importing: an import job is queued or running. needs_unit: the file declares no usable unit and the user must choose one. unconfirmed: a unit was detected and awaits the user's confirmation. ready: the unit is confirmed and topology.json is at that scale. failed: the import failed; problem says why.

GeometryView.description: A geometry as its owner sees it. Lengths in metres; the browser converts for display.

problem.description: Why the import failed, in plain language.

size.description: Bounding box diagonal in metres at the current scale.

GeometryResponse.description: Answer to POST /api/geometries (HTTP 201), GET /api/geometries/{id} and POST /api/geometries/{id}/unit.

GeometryListResponse.description: Answer to GET /api/geometries: the signed-in user's geometries, newest first.

ConfirmUnitRequest.description: Body of POST /api/geometries/{id}/unit: the length unit the file is really in.
